labels_from: pro-lettering-1102 picks.jsonl via the sealed map (LEFT=before, RIGHT=after)

thread_density: thread mm per mm^2 of sewn footprint, changed shapes
thread_density_whole: thread mm per mm^2 of sewn footprint, whole design
density_pro_gap: |whole-design density - the pro file's|, pro logos only
flow_circvar: circular variance of stitch direction within fill/satin shapes
turns_per_100mm: >30 deg direction changes per 100 mm of fill/satin thread
short_share: share of stitches under 1 mm, changed shapes
long_share: share of stitches over 4 mm, changed shapes
runs_per_shape: sewn runs per changed shape (pieces a shape is sewn in)
back_share_thread: underlay_cover: back stitching, share of thread (reused)
top_support: underlay_cover: top thread laid on thread (reused)
trims_per_1000: trims per 1000 stitches (recomputed here; the #842 control)
